headline: After the "elevator door" scandal, shares transferred to wife: Shenghong Technology gives all listed bosses another lesson
summary: Shenghong Technology chairman Chen Tao plans to transfer his 39% stake in Shenghua Xinye and 35% stake in Hongda Investment to his wife, Liu Chunlan. The company announced the arrangement on August 28.
why: Shenghong Technology is a listed Chinese manufacturer, and changes in founder ownership can affect governance and investor confidence.
